pr_title: ddl: watch the ddl ownerkey with the createRevision
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
A tidb-server run campaignOwner successfully and become owner. If it watches the owner after the ownerKey is deleted, the watchOwner() will be stuck. 
The method to fix it: need to watch the owner since createRevision.

<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/54689, ref #54436

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/2088b342e8f04f362d84cd54ab99f9fc7dc56ddf/pkg/owner/manager.go#L449
- tidb2 become owner

we should watch since the revision when we become owner to get notified
